summary: Discussion-sourced signals clustered into product launches, operator workflows, and infra primitives. High-priority: Meta Muse Code launch, Cloudflare WriteGuard/MCP controls, and Reuters security story on OpenAI/Anthropic agents. Several operator reports (memory, Runlayer) and sandbox/MCP tool launches require follow-up corroboration. | Vendor releases and platform updates: Anthropic Opus 5, Cloudflare OS/Agent Access Model + WriteGuard, Mistral product suite, Vercel AI Gateway updates, Google model-routing/load balancing, Modal sandboxes, Daytona sandbox updates/funding, AWS S3 materialized views, Cursor product additions, JetBrains IntelliJ LSP. | GitHub OSS snapshot: multiple vendor releases (Gemini CLI, OpenAI Codex, Anthropic Claude Code, Vercel AI, Qwen Live Host, Mem0 SDK) plus prominent infra primitives (Agent-Sandbox, Mitos) and high-traction OSS agent frameworks (CowAgent, Dify, Omnigent). No social/discussion field reports in this shard — operator workflows missing. | Package-level snapshot: official OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs plus many infra primitives for agent eval, MCP, memory, sandboxing and agent observability. Missing social/operator reports for workflow signals.
